direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale genuinely feels very cheap and tacky, the kill sequences are entertaining, but they are nothing really special; the direction on a microscale is so bland and bad, but not even like campy to where it is entertaining; storytelling is so straightforward that it dumbs down what is going on for the audience, especially with the out-of-place narration; builds tension very poorly because everything looks tacky or is just explained to the audience

performance.comments: Shows no emotion or range whatsoever; has no chemistry with his co-stars; and is just kinda there in the action sequences
Feels very forced and unnatural; doesn't have much chemistry with her co-stars

cast.comments: Everyone just gives very flat and lifeless performances that you would expect from a low-budget horror movie; there is no chemistry in the cast as everything feels stiff and unnatural

story.comments: The concept is honestly pretty stupid and not really that interesting; even though it is explained, the conflict just does not make any sense because there is no 'why'; the plot structure is very linear because it is basically an advent calendar and it is explained via days on screen; character writing is very bad because they explain why these characters do what they do, but they are just so surface-level and so poorly written that you do not care for them at all

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is very bad, and not even campy bad; The humor is forced and not good, maybe hitting one every six times; The symbolism is too shallow to care; The foreshadowing is not really that good

cinematography.comments: Feels very low budget and tacky

editing.comments: Feels very low-budget and tacky; I thought the Scott Pilgrim style kill edits were pretty cool

sound.comments: Feels very low-budget and tacky; So many times where the movie is just void of sound or is improperly mixed in

visual_effects.comments: Looks incredibly low-budget and tacky; Even though this is probably a low-budget film, I have seen way better kill sequences done for cheaper

review.pacing: Pacing is incredibly slow for how bad it is
review.climax: Climax is honestly not that interesting because I was just waiting for this movie to end
review.tone: Tone is just a bad, low-budget slasher movie that poses as a Christmas movie
review.final_notes: Saw the world premiere as a secret screening at Fantastic Fest
review.overall: Overall, a very bad, low-budget Christmas slasher movie that just feels tackier and more boring than campy and fun; to be fair, this movie isn't really for me and I watched it at midnight, so I really wasn't in the mood to watch it
